# Mod downloads

`TCSShopOwnershipFix-v1.0.0.zip` is the optional Shop Ownership Fix plugin, built
from the included source and confirmed working by the user. Install its ZIP in
`Mods` without extracting it. See the [main README](../README.md) for details.

The current loader is [TCSModLoader-v1.7.4.zip](TCSModLoader-v1.7.4.zip), with separate character-pack names, larger character/shop limits, blank-portrait and save-load crash fixes, Saga Tweaks compatibility, and automatic priority sorting. Earlier published loader ZIPs remain for reference. The plugin ZIPs are preserved supplied builds. See the [main README](../README.md) for installation and the [1.7.4 release notes](../docs/releases/TCSModLoader-v1.7.4.md) for validation details. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers the repository's tracked ZIP downloads and current release.

`archive/` preserves older First Person and Ally Damage packages. Early First Person builds used their own `d3d9.dll`; do not install those alongside the standalone loader by overwriting its DLL. First Person 0.3.11 and 0.4.0 are plugin packages. Prefer the current packages listed in the main README.

Historical ZIPs do not imply that matching historical source revisions are available. The repository contains the current source snapshot. Newly built packages go under `build/packages/`, separate from these preserved downloads.
